purpose: Teach: 前掲/ケ月/バラエティー/実費/従前/学士/専従/枠内

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、調書の前掲箇所を再確認されますね
lines.en: You're reviewing those earlier sections of the police statement again, aren't you.
lines.style: Measured, slightly deferential tone. Acknowledging a procedural necessity without urgency. Warm but businesslike. The cadence of someone supporting a process.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査は六ケ月かけて慎重に進められますね
lines.en: The investigation is being handled carefully over six months, I see.
lines.style: Calm, respectful observation. Soft emphasis on the duration — not rushed. Patient pacing. The tone of someone understanding the weight of thoroughness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪手口のバラエティーが増えてますね
lines.en: Crime methods are becoming more varied these days, aren't they.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost conversational. A gentle observation stated as fact. Even tempo. The voice of someone noticing patterns without judgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害弁償の実費を被害者にご説明されますね
lines.en: You're explaining the actual costs of victim compensation to them directly.
lines.style: Approving undertone. Straightforward, clear delivery. Slight warmth on the recognition that this is the right approach. Steady, no apology.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、従前の取り扱いを尊重しつつ改善されますね
lines.en: You're improving procedures while respecting how things were handled before.
lines.style: Acknowledging the balance required. Measured respect in the pacing. Recognition that this is both careful and progressive — not easy. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、警察学校の学士課程卒業生も活躍されてますね
lines.en: The police academy graduates with bachelor's degrees are doing good work too, aren't they.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Easy, affirming tone without flattery. Natural cadence of someone genuinely noticing competence. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、専従の捜査チームを設置されましたね
lines.en: You've set up a dedicated investigation team for this.
lines.style: Clear acknowledgment of action taken. Firm but not commanding. Recognition that this is significant — not small. Even, grounded delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、職務の枠内で対応されてますね
lines.en: You're handling it all within the proper scope of your duties.
lines.style: Quiet approval. Close, almost intimate register — no distance between speaker and listener. Steady, dependable tone. The voice of someone saying: I see what you're doing.
